company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. It simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration to create better APIs faster.
icp: Engineers, development teams, and enterprises of all sizes (from individuals to Fortune 500 companies) involved in building, testing, managing, and distributing APIs.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service platform that provides developers with a suite of tools including a Postgres database, authentication, edge functions, storage, and real-time capabilities. It allows users to build and scale applications rapidly by integrating these best-of-breed products into a unified platform.
icp: Supabase targets developers, startups, and fast-growing companies looking for a scalable, open-source backend solution to build and manage their applications, particularly those using frameworks like React, Next.js, Flutter, and Expo React Native.

company_overview: Vapi provides a platform for builders to create, deploy, and improve voice agents rapidly. It offers a unified platform with orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise-grade configurability for scalable voice AI solutions.
icp: Developers, builders, and enterprises looking to integrate voice AI agents for various use cases like customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling, with a focus on scalability and compliance.
